title: Comfort Club Reinstated-Term Dues by Reinstatement Gap
content:
The amount billed for the dues of a reinstated Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements term follows the gap rule.

**Reinstatement gap.** The calendar days from the lapsed term's last day — the day before the agreement's current term start — to the date of handling.

## Gap rule
1. **Gap of more than 30 days (the full-gap days) and at least 5 consecutive terms (the gap term count):** the discounted dues multiplied by the whole calendar months counted as complete month-to-month steps from the date of handling that end on or before the term end, divided by twelve.
2. **Gap of more than 15 days (the partial-gap days), not meeting the first condition:** the discounted dues multiplied by the calendar days from the date of handling through the term end, both counted, divided by 365.
3. **Any other agreement:** the discounted dues for the whole term.

Each prorated amount is rounded to the cent half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: reinstated term 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026, discounted dues 418.00)

| Date of handling | Gap | Consecutive terms | Working | Amount billed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2025 | 10 days | any | whole term | 418.00 |
| 20 June 2025 | 20 days | any | 346 days through 31 May 2026, divided by 365 | 396.24 |
| 10 July 2025 | 40 days | 6 | 10 whole months (steps ending 10 August through 10 May), divided by twelve | 348.33 |
| 10 July 2025 | 40 days | 3 | 326 days, divided by 365 | 373.34 |

## Boundary points
- A gap of exactly 15 days bills the whole term; 16 days falls in the day-count band.
- A gap of exactly 30 days, even at 5 or more terms, falls in the day-count band.
